messages:
elaine: quick check — planning a canary for pii.flag.v2 (controls logging of raw request bodies). propose rollout: 1% internal -> 5% dev teams -> 25% beta orgs over 24h windows. KMS path should default to HSM for enterprise tenants; fallback to software-KMS if HSM unavailable. any objections?
chris: +1 on the percentages. add a 15m warmup at each step with health checks before the next increase. also want a guardrail to auto-disable if error_rate > 0.5% or p95 latency increases > 200ms.
ryan: who owns retention overrides here? current default is 30d, compliance asked for opt-in 90d for audit_mode. proposal: require explicit opt-in for >60d and audit_mode toggles retention to 90d.
samir: ops note — target deploy window tonight 22:00 UTC. if we enable HSM-only routing for some orgs, ensure kms-rotate job runs post-canary. I can add a job trigger and a smoke-test job.
devops-bot: deploy-lock created by samir at 1799000100. runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/ops/pii-flag-canary-runbook (contains rollback cmds, test vectors, and contact list)
elaine: can we also surface a fast kill switch? suggest ff:local-pii-disable that propagates immediately to all envs and bypasses batching so production can stop raw logging instantly. also need a short changelog blurb for platform-notes.
chris: I'll add a circuit-breaker implementation: on guardrail breach flip to 'scrubbed-logging' variant and page ops. opening PR to add metrics (error_rate, p95, token_lag) and the toggle logic.
ryan: note on audit_mode: when enabled it should set retention=90d, store only hashed identifiers in logs, and prefer HSM-backed KMS. privacy team also wants an explicit opt-in audit entry recorded per org.
samir: pushed a draft feature-flag manifest to infra repo. snippet below: 
```yaml
# infra/flags/pii_logging_v2.yaml
name: pii.logging.v2
default: off
canary_sequence:
  - name: internal-1pct
    percent: 1
    duration: 6h
  - name: devteams-5pct
    percent: 5
    duration: 6h
  - name: beta-orgs-25pct
    percent: 25
    duration: 12h
guardrails:
  error_rate_threshold: 0.005
  p95_latency_ms_threshold: 200
fallbacks:
  on_guardrail_breach: scrubbed-logging
  kms_fallback: software-kms
```
elaine: LGTM. final asks before we flip: explicit list of canary orgs, exact rollback command, and a 1-line smoke test checklist. I'll post to #all-hands after we agree.
chris: canary orgs: redwood-internal, qa-team-2, beta-analytics. rollback command: `./ops rollback --flag pii.logging.v2 --to off --reason "canary breach"`
devops-bot: smoke test created: send 10 requests of small/medium/large payload to /v1/generate, confirm token-logging disabled in traces, check p95 under baseline, verify no errors. alerting hooks set for error_rate and p95.
security-eng: I'll run a quick KMS permission audit and confirm HSM admin accounts exist for enterprise tenants. will verify kms:encrypt for service account and that rotation role is present.
elaine: :thumbsup: all right, proceeding to schedule the canary. I'll update the runbook with these details and link the PR. ping if anything changes.
_meta_note: Generated synthetic Slack thread for canary coordination on PII/retention/KMS guardrails
